en: Multiview color postcard showing landmarks associated with Suceava, Romania: an equestrian statue of Stephen the Great on a tall plinth, the 16th‑century Moldovița Monastery church, a modern roundabout and the 'Moda' complex, and the House of Culture of Trade Unions with landscaped squares and socialist‑era apartment blocks. Reverse has Romanian handwriting dated 31.05.81, a 'POSTA ROMANA' 40 bani stamp, Suceava/București postmarks, and an address to Bucharest.
